gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: In 2018 the Syndicate recorded a prior-year release of technical claims reserves of GBP 8.3m (a reduction vs 2017), representing approximately 17.7% of opening gross claims outstanding (GBP 46.84m). The release arose predominantly from the nuclear property class and is attributed to favourable prior-year claims development and reassessment of exposures; no specific quantified event was given as the driver. Several historical and recent named catastrophic events (e.g. Fukushima 2011; hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria in 2017; Florence and Michael in 2018; Hurricane Andrew 1992) are discussed in the report but the syndicate indicates limited or no significant claims advices from the 2017/2018 hurricanes for the nuclear portfolio.
